privacy.metaDescription: What data this site collects and how it's used.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This site is a personal portfolio for {name}. It collects very little data, and this page explains exactly what and why.
privacy.formBody: If you use the contact form, the name, email address, and message you submit are sent directly to my email inbox so I can reply. This data is not stored in a database on this site, not sold, and not shared with third parties beyond the email delivery provider used to send the message.
privacy.cookiesBody: This site stores your theme (dark, light, or high contrast) and accent color choice in your browser's local storage so your preference persists between visits. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
privacy.hostingBody: This site is hosted on Vercel, which may process standard server logs (such as IP address and request metadata) as part of serving the site. Any analytics added in the future will be privacy-respecting and will not track you across other websites.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy can be sent to

Project names, client names, and outcomes described are accurate to the best of my knowledge. Logos, screenshots, and brand references belong to their respective owners and are used here only to illustrate work delivered.

terms.ipBody: The design, code, and written content of this site are my own work and may not be copied or reused without permission, unless explicitly published as open source.
terms.freelanceBody: Contacting me through this site does not create a client relationship or contractual obligation. Any paid work is governed by a separate agreement made directly between us before work begins.
